name: Thumb MCP Joint Dislocation
definition: Dislocation of the thumb metacarpophalangeal joint, usually dorsal after hyperextension trauma and occasionally irreducible due to soft-tissue interposition.

investigations.principle: Radiographs are required before and after reduction when feasible.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, occult injury, postoperative or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Irreducible or unstable dislocations may require open reduction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Angushtha-Sandhi displacement phenotype may be documented after modern reduction.

patientEducation.summary: Dislocation of the thumb metacarpophalangeal joint, usually dorsal after hyperextension trauma and occasionally irreducible due to soft-tissue interposition.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, respiratory distress, progressive neurological deficit, open injury, severe deformity, infection or other listed red flags.
